## Goal

Document the herdr worklist hydrator in packages/herdr/README.md so operators understand its cadence, semantics, safety, and why pane-title IDs must survive truncation.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. README documents: 30s cadence, immediate run on focus-resume, visibility gating (zero wl while hidden).
2. README documents demotion rules (in_review→completed, dependency-blocked→blocked, else→open) with the status/stage compatibility note.
3. README documents fail-open semantics (missing/unparseable CLI output → no demotions, never a crash).
4. README documents the pane-title ID-survival rationale (matching relies on ' - WL-<id>' in titles; pane-title amendment F0).
5. Docs match the shipped implementation (reviewed at close).

## Key Files

- packages/herdr/README.md

## Minimal Implementation

1. Add a 'Hydrator' subsection under the worklist/downtime worker docs area with the bullets above.

## Dependencies

- Requires F2 (implementation facts) and F0 (format rationale)

# Retention sweep script with `--check` and unit tests

Deliver a stdlib-only, repo-local retention sweep that discovers stale
`audit_debug_*.jsonl` forensic dumps on this host and removes those that exceed
an age or size threshold. Conventions are mirrored from the SorraAgents audit
skill's `cleanup_debug_logs.py`, which is **referenced, not forked**
(repo-boundary rule: do not edit `~/.pi/agent/skills/audit` or `skill/audit`).

## Scope

- New `scripts/prune_audit_debug_logs.py` (executable, standard library only).
- Discovery: every `~/projects/*/.worklog/` store (files directly in the store —
  non-recursive, so worktree sub-directories are not swept) and
  `~/.audit_debug/**` (recursive). Repeatable `--root <path>` overrides make
  discovery testable against a `tmp_path` tree.
- Name guard: only files whose basename matches `audit_debug_*.jsonl` are ever
  considered. `worklog.db`, `worklog.db-wal`, `worklog.db-shm`, `config.yaml`,
  worktrees and every other file are never selected.
- Selection: a candidate is selected when its `mtime` is strictly older than
  `--older-than` days (default 7) **or** its size is strictly greater than
  `--max-size` MB (default 50).
- Modes: dry-run is the default (prints the selected set and aggregate bytes);
  `--apply` deletes the selected set; `--check` deletes nothing and exits
  non-zero when the remaining debug-log footprint exceeds `--budget-gb`
  (default 5).
- Robustness: an `OSError` on stat/unlink skips that file and continues (the
  sweep never aborts mid-set); every removed file emits one audit line
  (path + bytes) to stdout and, when `--log-file` is given, to an append-only
  log.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `scripts/prune_audit_debug_logs.py` is a standalone stdlib-only executable Python 3 script whose discovery finds `audit_debug_*.jsonl` directly under each `~/projects/*/.worklog/` store and recursively under `~/.audit_debug/**`, honours `--root` overrides, returns no candidates for a missing root, and documents every flag and default in `--help`.
2. Selection is name-guarded to `audit_debug_*.jsonl` and selects only files strictly older than `--older-than` days (default 7) OR strictly larger than `--max-size` MB (default 50); all other files are never selected or deleted.
3. Dry-run is the default and changes nothing on disk; `--apply` deletes exactly the selected set, emits one audit line per removed file (path + bytes), and a second `--apply` immediately afterwards reports zero candidates.
4. `--check` deletes nothing, exits 0 when the remaining debug-log footprint is within `--budget-gb` (default 5), and exits non-zero when it exceeds that budget.
5. An `OSError` while stat-ing or unlinking a candidate is logged and skipped — the sweep continues and still processes the remaining candidates.
6. `pytest tests/test_prune_audit_debug_logs.py` passes and covers the age boundary (just inside/outside), size boundary (just under/over), non-matching-name safety, missing-root no-op, dry-run no-op, `--apply` exact set, `--check` under/over-budget exit codes, second-apply idempotence, and OSError skip-and-continue.

**Key Files:**

- `scripts/prune_audit_debug_logs.py` — new: discovery, selection, dry-run/`--apply`/`--check`
- `tests/test_prune_audit_debug_logs.py` — new: pytest coverage driven by `tmp_path`

## Notes

Write the tests first (TDD); the item is complete only when the whole module is
green. The `.worklog/*` path is git-ignored in this repo, so no tracked data is
affected.
data.title: Retention sweep script with --check and unit tests

# Reclaim legacy backlog and record evidence

Run the retention sweep with `--apply` against the real host state and record
the before/after evidence on the parent work item (`WL-0MUJL0PTS009MC8F`).
This is the verification item for parent AC2.

## Scope

- Capture the before-state: file count and `du -sh` for
  `ContextHub/.worklog`, `open_source_llm/.worklog` and `~/.audit_debug`.
- Run `python3 scripts/prune_audit_debug_logs.py --apply` with the documented
  thresholds (7 days / 50 MB).
- Capture the after-state and the reclaimed total.
- Confirm no non-debug file was removed (`worklog.db`, WAL/SHM if present and
  `config.yaml` intact) and the live worklog still works.
- Record aggregate counts/sizes **only** (never log contents — forensic dumps
  may contain provider payloads) as a comment on the parent work item, then
  verify a second `--apply` reports no candidates.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. Before/after file counts are recorded and ContextHub `.worklog` shows 48 → 0 `audit_debug_*.jsonl` files while `open_source_llm/.worklog` shows 33 → 0.
2. `ls <store>/audit_debug_*.jsonl` returns nothing for both stores after the sweep.
3. The reclaimed total is ≥ 20 GB and is recorded as aggregate numbers (`du -sh` before/after plus the delta) in a comment on parent `WL-0MUJL0PTS009MC8F` — no log contents.
4. `~/.audit_debug` is swept to its new bounded footprint and its before/after size is recorded.
5. Non-debug files are untouched: `worklog.db` and `config.yaml` still exist in both stores, and `wl show WL-0MUJL0PTS009MC8F` still succeeds after the sweep.
6. A second `--apply` run reports zero candidates (idempotent against real state).

**Key Files:**

- `scripts/prune_audit_debug_logs.py` — consumed; fix-forward here only if the real run exposes a defect
- `.worklog/config.yaml` — protected non-debug file that must survive the sweep
data.title: Reclaim legacy audit_debug backlog and record evidence

# Cron automation installer with idempotence tests

Install and remove the machine-scoped daily sweep as an idempotent cron entry,
so pruning cannot silently stop (parent AC3, recurrence prevention).

## Scope

- New `scripts/install-audit-log-hygiene.sh` (bash, `set -euo pipefail`):
  - default action installs exactly one managed crontab line running
    `scripts/prune_audit_debug_logs.py --apply --log-file ~/.audit_debug/hygiene-cron.log`;
  - idempotent: re-running validates the managed line (stable marker comment)
    and reports "already installed" instead of appending a second copy;
  - `--remove` deletes only the managed marker line, leaving unrelated crontab
    entries untouched;
  - `--dry-run` prints the intended crontab change and writes nothing;
  - bounded log: `~/.audit_debug/hygiene-cron.log` is truncated/rotated once it
    exceeds a configurable cap (default 5 MB) so the hygiene log itself cannot
    become the next runaway.
- Tests exercise the installer through a temp `HOME`/crontab seam so the
  operator's real crontab is never touched.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `scripts/install-audit-log-hygiene.sh` installs exactly one managed crontab entry running the sweep with `--apply`; re-running is idempotent and reports "already installed".
2. `--remove` removes only the managed entry and preserves every unrelated crontab line.
3. `--dry-run` prints the intended change and leaves the crontab unchanged.
4. The managed entry appends to `~/.audit_debug/hygiene-cron.log`, which is truncated/rotated once it exceeds the configured cap so the log stays bounded.
5. Tests pass without touching the operator's real crontab (temp `HOME`/crontab seam) and assert idempotence plus preserve-unrelated-lines behaviour.

**Key Files:**

- `scripts/install-audit-log-hygiene.sh` — new: idempotent cron install / `--remove` / `--dry-run`
- `tests/test_install_audit_log_hygiene.py` — new: installer tests via a temp crontab seam

## Notes

The copy-paste `crontab -l` fallback snippet for operators who decline the
helper is documented in the retention runbook
(`docs/dev/audit-debug-log-retention.md`, sibling item). Write the tests first
(TDD); the item is complete only when the whole module is green.
data.title: Cron automation installer with idempotence tests

# Document retention policy and runbook

Write the retention policy/runbook page and wire it into the docs index so the
behaviour is discoverable and copy-paste runnable (parent AC4 and the
documentation half of parent AC5).

## Scope

- New `docs/dev/audit-debug-log-retention.md` covering:
  - locations swept (`~/projects/*/.worklog/` non-recursive,
    `~/.audit_debug/**` recursive) and the `~/.audit_debug` vs legacy
    `.worklog` distinction: `audit_runner.py` now writes to
    `~/.audit_debug/<project-slug>/` and deletes on success, so `.worklog`
    dumps are legacy and will not regrow;
  - thresholds (7 days / 50 MB defaults, CLI-configurable) and the
    `--budget-gb` (default 5) budget;
  - dry-run/`--apply`/`--check` semantics and safety guarantees (name guard;
    never touches `worklog.db*`, `config.yaml` or worktrees; OSError
    skip-and-continue; aggregate-only reporting, never log contents);
  - cron install/removal via `scripts/install-audit-log-hygiene.sh`
    (`--dry-run`, `--remove`), the bounded
    `~/.audit_debug/hygiene-cron.log`, **and** the exact copy-paste
    `crontab -l` snippet for operators who decline to run the helper;
  - relationship to the SorraAgents audit skill's `cleanup_debug_logs.py`
    (14-day retention, `~/.audit_debug` only; referenced not forked) and the
    explicit out-of-scope follow-ups (machine-hygiene skill
    `WL-0MUJLCVRS0093EJJ`, pre-push enforcement).
- Link the page from the `README.md` documentation table.
- Update script header/docstrings and installer comments to match the
  documented policy.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `docs/dev/audit-debug-log-retention.md` exists and documents locations, thresholds, dry-run/`--apply`/`--check` semantics, cron install/removal, safety guarantees and the `~/.audit_debug` vs legacy `.worklog` distinction.
2. Every command in the page is copy-paste runnable as written (verified, no undefined placeholders) and the page states the configurable `--budget-gb` default.
3. The page includes the exact `crontab -l` copy-paste snippet for operators who decline the installer helper.
4. The page is linked from the `README.md` documentation table, and the link resolves to the new file.
5. Code comments/docstrings in `scripts/prune_audit_debug_logs.py` and `scripts/install-audit-log-hygiene.sh` reflect the documented policy.
6. The full project test suite passes with the new changes (`npm test` for vitest and `pytest tests/test_prune_audit_debug_logs.py tests/test_install_audit_log_hygiene.py`).

**Key Files:**

- `docs/dev/audit-debug-log-retention.md` — new: policy + runbook
- `./README.md` — docs table entry linking the new page
- `scripts/prune_audit_debug_logs.py` — header/docstring aligned to the policy
- `scripts/install-audit-log-hygiene.sh` — installer comments aligned to the policy
data.title: Document audit debug log retention policy and runbook

## Audit-debug backlog reclaimed — before/after evidence (WL-0MUJRQNVZ0008F47, parent AC2)

Ran `python3 scripts/prune_audit_debug_logs.py --apply` (thresholds: older-than 7 days OR > 50 MB). Aggregate numbers only; no log contents recorded.

### Before
| Location | `audit_debug_*.jsonl` files | `du -sh` |
|---|---|---|
| `ContextHub/.worklog` | 48 | 13G |
| `open_source_llm/.worklog` | 33 | 11G |
| `~/.audit_debug` (recursive) | 26068 | 2.5G |
| Other `~/projects/*/.worklog` (SorraAgents) | 2 | — |

### Sweep result
- Discovered: 26,151 candidates; selected: 20,882; removed: **20,882 files / 26,110,971,282 bytes (~24.3 GiB reclaimed by sum of sizes)**.
- Exit code 0; no `OSError` skips.

### After
| Location | `audit_debug_*.jsonl` files | `du -sh` |
|---|---|---|
| `ContextHub/.worklog` | 0 | 461M |
| `open_source_llm/.worklog` | 0 | 375M |
| `~/.audit_debug` (recursive) | 5269 (age/size-bounded) | 353M |

`du` deltas: ContextHub −12.5G, open_source_llm −10.6G, ~/.audit_debug −2.2G → **≈25.3 GiB reclaimed**, exceeding the ≥20 GB target.

### Safety checks
- `worklog.db` and `config.yaml` still present and unchanged in both stores.
- `wl show WL-0MUJL0PTS009MC8F` succeeds after the sweep (live SQLite worklog unaffected).
- Second `--apply` reports **0 candidate(s) selected out of 5269 discovered** — idempotent against real state.
